Posts an invoice payable directly to the ledger without going through the approval workflow. The invoice must be in `IN_DRAFT` state. After posting, linked credit notes are applied and unlinked credit notes may be auto-allocated. If the invoice is fully cleared by credit notes, it transitions to `COMPLETED`; otherwise it transitions to `UNPAID`.

Reverses a clearing applied to an invoice payable — either a bank payment (`BP`) or a credit note (`CN`) — identified by its accounting document ID. Use the `List invoice payable payments` endpoint to obtain the `accountingDocumentId` and `type` of the clearing to reverse. Reversing removes the clearing's effect from the ledger and transitions the invoice back to `UNPAID` or `PARTIALLY_PAID` depending on the remaining outstanding balance. Optionally set `shouldArchiveClearingDocument` to also archive the underlying bank payment or credit note.
